tunnel.passage_other_detail: Clear 'tube waterslide' / see-through tube; bright inside because Jesus was in it; colors flying by (later interpreted as galaxies/universes).
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described as being in a tube with colors flying by; explicitly notes never being in a downward position.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus/Heavenly Father present; described as a man who was also bright light; white robe; staff with cradle and hovering spinning sphere; giant/tall; throne; lap experience; showed left eye with iris like a 'blue world'.
arrival.other_being_detail: A 'nice lady' served food (juicy fruit); 'part of me wants to say she was blue'.

environment.environment_other_detail: All-white realm; 'Jesus’ courtyard'; gazebo/platform-stage structures; doorframe/portal not attached to a house; heard joyful 'picnic' sounds behind the door; food served (juicy fruit).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Concern about leaving best friend; concern about cats; panic/anxiety about returning decision.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Does not remember returning via tube/wormhole; remembers rolling off Jesus’ lap and then being back, feeling heavy.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Felt need to 'go back to earth to bring others to Him' / help Jesus 'get His children Home' and help people revisit words of Christ; told to stay close so she can hear him call.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Three heart attacks in hospital (surgery-related context noted); CPR given; longest death approx. 15–18 minutes per friend report.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Non-denominational Christian (followed words of Christ Jesus).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Non-denominational Christian; did not attend church.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Throne/lap interaction; door/portal with joyful sounds; teachings about fellowship, forgiveness, kindness, harming children; language not English (speculated Aramaic).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE then tube/tunnel with Jesus/light; arrival in all-white realm; extended interaction/teaching; door/portal boundary; return decision; return by 'rolling off his lap'.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: States Jesus 'came to me three times' corresponding to three deaths/heart attacks.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Jesus’ staff with cradle and hovering spinning sphere; Jesus showing left eye with iris like a 'blue world'; speaking a non-English language fluently (speculated Aramaic); eating food served by a 'nice lady' (possibly blue); gazebo/platform stages with cooking/music; 'super being with a big S on my chest' feeling; doorframe/portal not attached to a house with joyful 'picnic' sounds.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Jesus came to me three times.'; 'Get up. Do you want to come?'; 'I am losing a lot of my lambs.'; 'Woe to those that hurt the children.'; 'But he cannot hurt you. And he knows it.'; 'Don't go too far to where you can't hear me call you.'
